neighborhoods.name: Upper East Side
neighborhoods.description: The Upper East Side is one of Manhattan's most prestigious residential neighborhoods, renowned for its tree-lined streets, pre-war architecture, and proximity to Central Park. This refined enclave offers a sophisticated lifestyle with world-class museums, boutique shopping, and acclaimed dining.
neighborhoods.vibe: Elegant and refined with a welcoming residential atmosphere. Quiet tree-lined streets contrast with the bustling avenues. A mix of longtime residents and young professionals seeking classic Manhattan living.

attractions.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
attractions.description: One of the world's largest and finest art museums

attractions.name: Central Park
attractions.description: 843 acres of green space with running paths and playgrounds
attractions.address: Fifth Avenue to Central Park West

neighborhoods.name: Upper West Side
neighborhoods.description: The Upper West Side embodies the intellectual and artistic spirit of Manhattan. Home to Lincoln Center, Columbia University, and the American Museum of Natural History.
neighborhoods.vibe: Artsy, intellectual, and community-focused. A laid-back alternative to the Upper East Side with notable cultural institutions.

attractions.name: American Museum of Natural History
attractions.description: Iconic museum with dinosaur fossils and Hayden Planetarium

neighborhoods.name: Tribeca
neighborhoods.description: Tribeca has evolved from industrial warehouses to Manhattan's most expensive residential neighborhood. Its cobblestone streets and converted loft spaces attract celebrities, financiers, and families.
neighborhoods.vibe: Ultra-exclusive yet surprisingly approachable. Celebrity sightings are common, but the neighborhood maintains a village-like feel.

attractions.name: Hudson River Park
attractions.description: Waterfront park spanning 5 miles with piers and playgrounds

neighborhoods.name: Chelsea
neighborhoods.description: Chelsea is Manhattan's art gallery capital, with over 200 galleries. Also home to the High Line, Chelsea Market, and a thriving community.
neighborhoods.vibe: Artsy, progressive, and vibrant. A hub for the creative class with a strong community feel.

attractions.name: The High Line
attractions.description: Elevated linear park built on historic freight rail lines

attractions.name: Chelsea Market
attractions.description: Indoor food hall in a former Nabisco factory

neighborhoods.name: Greenwich Village
neighborhoods.description: Greenwich Village is one of New York's most desirable and historic neighborhoods. Known for its bohemian past, winding streets, and charming townhouses.
neighborhoods.vibe: Eclectic and charming with a strong artistic heritage. Tree-lined streets and intimate cafes create a village-within-the-city atmosphere.

attractions.name: Washington Square Park
attractions.description: Iconic park with the Washington Square Arch
